title: Pure Vision HERO
summary: Vision HERO cards only, with Polymerization, one generic HERO Link, staples and an automatic Extra Deck. The page's wider HERO build (Destiny HEROes, Stratos, Mask Change) belongs on those lists. Vision HEROes are DARK Warriors, and most of the 2019 wave can sit in your Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Traps. Vision HERO Faris discards another HERO to summon itself, then places a Vision HERO from the Deck there. Those Trap-Zone HEROes tribute a HERO to summon themselves in the Main Phase and fire on arrival. Increase calls another small Vision HERO from the Deck, Minimum Ray destroys a small monster, and Poisoner halves a monster's ATK. Vision HERO Gravito tributes itself to summon two of them at once. Vision HERO Vyon mills a HERO and searches Polymerization. Vision Fusion can also use the HEROes sitting as Traps as material for Vision HERO Adoration or Trinity. Faris locks the Extra Deck to HEROes for the turn.
main: Vision HERO Faris
Discards a HERO to summon itself; places a Vision HERO as a Continuous Trap.
Vision HERO Vyon
Mills a HERO; banishes one to search Polymerization.
Vision HERO Increase
From the Trap Zone: summons itself, then a small Vision HERO from the Deck.
Vision HERO Gravito
Recovers a banished HERO; tributes itself to summon two Trap-Zone Vision HEROes.
Vision HERO Minimum Ray
From the Trap Zone: summons itself and destroys a small monster.
Vision HERO Poisoner
From the Trap Zone: summons itself and halves a monster's ATK.
Vision HERO Multiply Guy
From the Trap Zone: summons itself and gives 800 ATK.
Vision HERO Witch Raider
Tributes Traps to summon itself; wipes their Spells and Traps.
Vision Fusion
Fusion Summons a HERO, using Trap-Zone HEROes as material.
Vision Release
Summons a Trap-Zone Vision HERO; recovers one from the GY.
Polymerization
Untagged Fusion Spell that Vyon searches.
Apparition
Calls a small Vision HERO when your HERO is destroyed; halves a monster.
extra: Fusion of two HEROes: shrinks their monster by a HERO's ATK.
Fusion of three HEROes: doubles its ATK and attacks three times.
Allowed HERO Link-2: re-Sets Polymerization or Vision Fusion when a HERO joins it.
Level 8 Fusion: Quick Effect destroys 1 card you control and 1 card on field, and revives itself next Standby Phase.
Level 6 Fusion: banishes all cards sent to the opponent's GY and randomly banishes 1 card from their hand when they search.

allow.Xtra HERO Wonder Driver: Generic HERO Link the page calls mandatory; it re-Sets Polymerization or Vision Fusion from the GY.
allow.Destiny HERO - Destroyer Phoenix Enforce: Recurring Fusion boss that destroys cards as a Quick Effect and continuously revives from the GY.
allow.Masked HERO Dark Law: Macro Cosmos floodgate on legs that punishes opponent's searches by ripping cards from hand.
